applications.formCss:
<style>
/* MBERP Swiss Clinical v2 — Casdoor Identity Sign-In Theme (v3 AntD & v4 AuthLayout) */
body:has(.login-content),
.login-background:not([style*="background-image"]) {
  background: #F6F8FA;
  color: #0F172A;
  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Inter", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

.login-content .login-panel:not(.login-panel-bleed) {
  background: #FFFFFF;
  border: 1px solid #D8E0E8;
  border-radius: 6px;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04);
}

.login-content .login-form {
  color: #0F172A;
}

.login-content .login-logo-box {
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.login-content .text-muted-foreground,
.login-content .login-signup-link,
.login-content .ant-form-item-extra {
  color: #64748B;
}

/* Inputs, selects & verification code fields — crisp 1px #D8E0E8 border, 4px radius */
.login-form input:not([type="checkbox"]):not([type="radio"]),
.login-form [role="combobox"],
.login-content .ant-input,
.login-content .ant-input-affix-wrapper,
.login-content .ant-select-selector {
  background: #FFFFFF;
  color: #0F172A;
  border: 1px solid #D8E0E8;
  border-radius: 4px;
  box-shadow: none;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.login-content .ant-input-affix-wrapper > input.ant-input {
  border: 0;
  box-shadow: none;
}

.login-form input:not([type="checkbox"]):not([type="radio"]):focus,
.login-form input:not([type="checkbox"]):not([type="radio"]):focus-visible,
.login-form [role="combobox"]:focus,
.login-content .ant-input:focus,
.login-content .ant-input-affix-wrapper-focused,
.login-content .ant-select-focused .ant-select-selector {
  border-color: #1E466B;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(30, 70, 107, 0.16);
  outline: none;
}

/* Primary action button — Swiss Clinical Deep Navy #1E466B, 4px radius, zero diffuse glow */
.login-form .login-button,
.login-content .ant-btn-primary {
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: #1E466B;
  border: 1px solid #1E466B;
  color: #FFFFFF;
  font-weight: 500;
  box-shadow: none;
}

.login-form .login-button:not(:disabled):hover,
.login-content .ant-btn-primary:not(:disabled):hover {
  background: #163654;
  border-color: #163654;
  color: #FFFFFF;
}

/* Secondary / outline buttons & checkboxes */
.login-form button[type="button"]:not(.login-button),
.login-content .ant-btn-default {
  border-radius: 4px;
  border-color: #D8E0E8;
  box-shadow: none;
}

.login-form [role="checkbox"][data-state="checked"],
.login-content .ant-checkbox-checked .ant-checkbox-inner {
  background-color: #1E466B;
  border-color: #1E466B;
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .login-content {
    padding-inline: 16px;
  }
  .login-content .login-panel:not(.login-panel-bleed),
  .login-content .login-panel-dark {
    max-width: 100%;
    border-radius: 6px;
  }
}

/* Restrained dark-mode fallback for apps that explicitly expose ThemeToggle */
html.dark body:has(.login-content),
html.dark .login-background:not([style*="background-image"]),
body:has(.login-panel-dark) {
  background: #0B131E;
  color: #F1F5F9;
}

html.dark .login-content .login-panel:not(.login-panel-bleed),
.login-content .login-panel-dark {
  background: #111D2B;
  border: 1px solid #26384C;
  border-radius: 6px;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.24);
}

html.dark .login-content .login-form,
.login-panel-dark .login-form {
  color: #F1F5F9;
}

html.dark .login-form input:not([type="checkbox"]):not([type="radio"]),
html.dark .login-form [role="combobox"],
.login-panel-dark .ant-input,
.login-panel-dark .ant-input-affix-wrapper,
.login-panel-dark .ant-select-selector {
  background: #0F1A27;
  color: #F1F5F9;
  border-color: #26384C;
}
</style>
